name: Kamoshida Chikamochi
source:
Occupation: Student
Stay as: Dweller

Another high schooler from the village of Fujiyoshi, Chikamochi has an odd and playful personality. He follows his instincts and this natural intuition is often proven right.

He lives in room 101 of the student dorm.

[Taken from the official art book included with the [url=/r65525]Day One Edition[/url].]
